reviews.shade: [Upgraded] Torriden Dive-In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Soothing Cream 100ml
reviews.text: An amazing, lightweight gel-cream that floods the skin with hydration. It cools down irritation immediately and leaves zero greasiness. Highly recommend for oily or combo skin!
reviews.zh: 非常出色嘅輕盈 gel-cream，可以即時為皮膚注滿水分。瞬即紓緩刺激感，完全唔油笠。強烈推薦畀油性肌或者混合性肌！

reviews.shade: [Upgraded] Torriden Dive-In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Soothing Cream 100ml
reviews.text: It's perfect!! Leaves the skin with full moisture and makes the skin look amazing
reviews.zh: 完美！！用完之後皮膚水分十足，望落去超靚

reviews.shade: [Upgraded] Torriden Dive-In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Soothing Cream 100ml
reviews.text:
この時期にこっくり系は重たいので、こちらを購入しました！
朝に使用してますが、ベタつかずにメイクの邪魔になりません。
お昼すぎには頬と顎が乾燥してしまうので、部分使いの方がいいかな？
使用感はすごく良いです！
reviews.zh:
而家呢個時節用厚重嘅太膩，所以揀咗呢款！
朝早用緊，唔黐立立，亦都唔會妨礙上妝。
到咗晏晝左右兩邊面頰同下巴位就會乾，所以局部用會比較好？
用後感覺超好！

reviews.zh: 用起上嚟非常保濕，防曬同控油效果之前就未試過。

reviews.text: Bought the cream for summer specifically, quite good

reviews.shade: [Upgraded] Torriden Dive-In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Soothing Cream 100ml
reviews.text: This cream is incredibly lightweight yet deeply hydrating. It feels like a burst of water on the skin, absorbing quickly and leaving a refreshing, non-greasy finish. It’s perfect for calming down irritated skin and locks in moisture all day."
reviews.zh: 呢隻霜輕盈得嚟又深層保濕。搽上面好似有一啲水爆開嘅感覺，吸收得好快，完妝清爽唔油笠。最適合用嚟舒緩受刺激嘅皮膚，全日都鎖住水分。

reviews.shade: [Upgraded] Torriden Dive-In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Soothing Cream 100ml
reviews.text: Im looking forward to trying this as summer approaches as someone with dry skin too.
reviews.zh: 夏天就嚟，我本身都係乾性肌，好期待試吓呢隻。
